Budget & Sustainability: 164–165 words, confirmed. No attachment filenames in the body.

Attachments to upload separately: district_k3_assessment_2023-24.pdf, community_survey_2024_summary.pdf, waitlist_summary_2024.pdf, budget_line_item_2026.xlsx, mous_and_support_letters.pdf, key_staff_resumes.pdf, evaluation_plan.pdf, evaluation_coord_resume.pdf, audit_2025.pdf, board_list_2026.pdf, pilot_report_parents_read_2023.pdf.

Visuals to insert: Logic model (one page, place in Program Design where the portal allows). Timeline table (place in Program Design after the Timeline paragraph).

Items still pending from earlier in our conversation: Confirm with the program officer whether supplemental data attachments are permitted. Confirm that the 160-family waitlist is unduplicated. Confirm the matched comparison group is feasible under the data-sharing agreement. Insert the in-kind dollar value from Riverview East Elementary and Westside Community Library once confirmed. Have a qualified translator review the Spanish survey and reading log before printing.

Let me know if you need anything else, whether that's the Project Summary (which we held), edits to the coach-copy materials, or help preparing the logic model or timeline table.
